titleEn: Maximum Sum Obtained of Any Permutation
title: 所有排列中的最大和
summary: 可任意排列 nums，多条请求贡献指定区间元素和，求总请求和最大值取模。
insight: 差分数组计算每个下标被请求覆盖次数。重排不等式表明，把最大数分配给最大覆盖次数可使加权和最大。
pitfalls: 差分在 right+1 处减一需判边界
排序两个数组后同序相乘

solutions.title: 覆盖频次与重排不等式
solutions.idea: 把元素值与位置权重各自排序后配对。
steps: 排序 nums 与 frequency，累加 nums[i]*frequency[i] 取模

code.java: class Solution { public int maxSumRangeQuery(int[] nums,int[][] requests){int n=nums.length;int[] frequency=new int[n+1];for(int[] request:requests){frequency[request[0]]++;frequency[request[1]+1]--;}for(int i=1;i<n;i++)frequency[i]+=frequency[i-1];Arrays.sort(nums);Arrays.sort(frequency,0,n);long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)answer=(answer+(long)nums[i]*frequency[i])%1_000_000_007L;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxSumRangeQuery(nums:IntArray,requests:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=nums.size;val frequency=IntArray(n+1);for(request in requests){frequency[request[0]]++;frequency[request[1]+1]--};for(i in 1 until n)frequency[i]+=frequency[i-1];nums.sort();frequency.sort(0,n);var answer=0L;for(i in 0 until n)answer=(answer+nums[i].toLong()*frequency[i])%1_000_000_007L;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxSumRangeQuery(vector<int>& nums,vector<vector<int>>& requests){int n=nums.size();vector<int> frequency(n+1);for(auto& request:requests){++frequency[request[0]];--frequency[request[1]+1];}for(int i=1;i<n;++i)frequency[i]+=frequency[i-1];sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());sort(frequency.begin(),frequency.begin()+n);long long answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)answer=(answer+1LL*nums[i]*frequency[i])%1000000007;return answer;} };
